description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers catalog for DevContainer configurations

metadata.format: Each entry under servers is a Claude Code .mcp.json mcpServers entry (type, command/args/env or url/headers) plus catalog-only fields (description, mode_minimum, category, requires) that must be dropped when copying. ${VAR} values are expanded by Claude Code from the environment it runs in.
metadata.usage: Reference catalog for docs/features/MCP.md. Nothing installs these automatically; users opt in by adding entries to .mcp.json at the project root (#386).

filesystem.description: Read/write files under the project root

memory.description: Knowledge-graph memory that persists across sessions

fetch.description: Fetch web pages and convert them to markdown

github.description: GitHub's hosted MCP server (repos, issues, PRs)

brave-search.description: Web search via the Brave Search API

playwright.description: Browser automation (replaces the archived puppeteer server)

requires.notes: Needs a browser in the image: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
